sdkReleases.name: PearfyGatewayLab
sdkReleases.summary: Optional deterministic in-process fake HTTP integrations

projectStatusSemantics.installed: Derived from the managed module lock or product references in Package.swift.
projectStatusSemantics.configured: Not inferred from package metadata; report not-verified unless an explicit configuration probe exists.
projectStatusSemantics.operational: Not inferred from source/docs; report not-verified unless a runtime/Guardian check has executable evidence.

modules.name: Pearfy core and HTTP
modules.summary: HTTP/NIO, route registry, controller macros, configuration, DI and application context
capabilities: HTTP router and typed controller macros
Route registry with template paths and groups
configurationChecks: Route/server/lifecycle registration is application code; package inspection cannot prove runtime wiring.
restrictions: TLS and WebSocket transports are not supplied by the current HTTP server
Use registered route templates, not concrete request paths, for metrics

modules.name: Pearfy security
modules.summary: JWT/API-key authentication and HTTP authorization policies
configurationChecks: Authentication and authorization middleware/policies must be configured by the application.
restrictions: Authorization is enforced by server middleware, never by client SDK omission
JWT fallback keys must be explicitly configured

modules.name: Pearfy social contracts
modules.summary: Social actors, graph policies, content contracts and moderation worker
configurationChecks: Application identity ownership and read-visibility policy require explicit wiring.
restrictions: Content/feed PostgreSQL storage and durable outbox are not implemented
Do not infer authorization from SDK exports

modules.name: Pearfy social PostgreSQL adapter
modules.summary: PostgreSQL persistence adapter for PearfySocial graph operations
configurationChecks: PostgreSQL service and adapter registration must be configured by the application.
restrictions: Social content/outbox persistence is not available in this adapter

modules.name: Pearfy Connect contracts
modules.summary: Route groups and typed contract metadata for HTTP operations
configurationChecks: Route groups and target schema discovery must be present in the application build.
restrictions: SDK generation and contract diff are not implemented
Route groups do not grant authorization

modules.name: Pearfy data and schema
modules.summary: Parameterized SQL, schema IR and initial PostgreSQL migration planning
configurationChecks: Schema IR/models and migration artifacts are application-specific.
restrictions: ORM query execution and complete migration lifecycle are not implemented
Never interpolate user values into SQL

modules.name: Pearfy transactions
modules.summary: Generic REQUIRED propagation and unit-of-work contract
configurationChecks: A store adapter must wrap one physical transaction and be bound by the application.
restrictions: Atomicity covers only the enlisted physical store transaction
Do not claim cross-database atomicity

modules.name: Pearfy PostgreSQL adapter
modules.summary: PostgreSQL connection, parameterized execution, migrations and transaction adapter
configurationChecks: Connection settings and PostgreSQL service must be configured by the application.
restrictions: Only PostgreSQL is supported by this adapter
Destructive migration changes require explicit approval

modules.name: PearfyPopulate
modules.summary: Bounded deterministic synthetic data generation for PostgreSQL
capabilities: Approved bounded batch execution and reports
configurationChecks: PostgreSQL endpoint, environment safeguards and execution approval are checked at runtime by the CLI.
restrictions: Local by default; staging needs explicit opt-in
No DDL, arbitrary SQL, cleanup, COPY, or unsupported schema coercion

modules.name: Pearfy cache
modules.summary: Bounded in-memory cache with metrics
configurationChecks: The application must register and use the cache; no external service is required for in-memory mode.
restrictions: The in-memory implementation is process-local
Redis behavior requires the redis module

modules.name: Pearfy messaging
modules.summary: Bounded in-memory message broker
configurationChecks: The application must register and use the process-local broker.
restrictions: In-memory messages do not survive process termination
Use redis only when its semantics are explicitly accepted

modules.name: Pearfy Redis adapters
modules.summary: Redis-backed cache and message broker adapters
configurationChecks: External Redis endpoint, authentication and TLS settings are application configuration.
restrictions: Requires a separately configured Redis service
Do not assume cache eviction or delivery guarantees beyond adapter contracts

modules.name: Pearfy jobs
modules.summary: Local fixed-delay scheduler
configurationChecks: Jobs must be registered with the application lifecycle.
restrictions: Schedule is process-local; durable distributed jobs are not implemented

modules.name: Pearfy outbound HTTP
modules.summary: Outbound HTTP concurrency limits and resilience policies
configurationChecks: Outbound endpoint, transport and resilience policies are application configuration.
restrictions: Retries must remain limited to idempotent operations
Remote endpoints require secure transport

modules.name: Pearfy application AI client
modules.summary: OpenAI-compatible application chat client
configurationChecks: Secure provider endpoint and backend-held credentials must be configured by the application.
restrictions: This is application runtime AI, separate from DevKit coding agents
Provider secrets stay server-side

modules.name: Pearfy observability primitives
modules.summary: Health/readiness and bounded Prometheus metrics
configurationChecks: Health probes, middleware and metrics routes must be explicitly installed by the application.
restrictions: Structured logs and distributed traces are not implemented
Metric label cardinality is bounded

modules.name: Pearfy DevKit UI
modules.summary: Optional authenticated development dashboard using live route templates and pluggable telemetry providers
capabilities: Live route registry and allowlisted HTTP metrics adapter
Bounded in-process route traces and correlated sanitized HTTP errors
configurationChecks: Router installation, enable flag, strong token and safe listener binding require explicit application configuration.
restrictions: Disabled by default and requires a bearer token when enabled
Distributed spans, logs, query, CPU, RSS and storage data need explicit providers
Never capture concrete request paths, query values, request/response bodies, credentials, cookies, exception messages or SQL bindings

modules.name: Pearfy testing support
modules.summary: Test context and dependency overrides
configurationChecks: Overrides are test code, not a runtime service; package test target must import the product.
restrictions: This module does not replace the package's Swift Testing or integration test setup

modules.name: Pearfy identity
modules.summary: Roadmap-only identity and credential linking; no installable product in this checkout
restrictions: Planned only; do not import or invent Identity APIs

modules.name: Pearfy social login
modules.summary: Roadmap-only OAuth/OIDC social login
restrictions: Planned only; no login, OAuth or credential APIs are available

modules.name: Pearfy payments
modules.summary: No PaymentEngine product exists in this checkout
restrictions: Planned only; do not implement financial APIs based on roadmap examples

modules.name: Pearfy backoffice
modules.summary: Roadmap-only backoffice authorization and UI module
restrictions: Planned only; no RBAC or backoffice products are available

modules.name: Pearfy approvals
modules.summary: Roadmap-only durable approval workflows
restrictions: Planned only; no approval workflow APIs are available

modules.name: Pearfy CRM
modules.summary: No CRM product exists in this checkout
restrictions: Planned only; no CRM APIs are available

modules.name: Pearfy chatbot
modules.summary: No chatbot workflow product exists in this checkout; PearfyAI is only an application chat client
restrictions: Planned only; do not treat PearfyAI chat completion as a chatbot workflow engine

modules.name: Pearfy logs
modules.summary: Structured logs/exporters are not implemented as a PearfyLogs module
restrictions: Planned only; do not claim structured logging or OTLP support

modules.name: Pearfy metric analytics
modules.summary: Existing Prometheus counters are in PearfyObservability; higher-level PearfyMetric analytics are not implemented
restrictions: Planned only; do not use the observability registry as PearfyMetric analytics

modules.name: Pearfy webhooks
modules.summary: No durable webhook/outbox product exists in this checkout
restrictions: Planned only; do not present webhook delivery guarantees as implemented

modules.name: Pearfy notifications
modules.summary: Social notification types exist, but no notification delivery module is implemented
restrictions: Planned only; notification delivery and persistence are not available

modules.name: Pearfy object storage
modules.summary: No object storage provider adapter exists in this checkout
restrictions: Planned only; no signed URL or object ownership APIs are available

modules.name: Pearfy realtime
modules.summary: No WebSocket/realtime fanout product exists in this checkout
restrictions: Planned only; no websocket or multi-instance realtime API is available

modules.name: Pearfy GatewayLab
modules.summary: Opt-in deterministic in-process fake HTTP provider and run-scoped scenario state
capabilities: Virtual clock delays and timeout/reset/malformed faults
Bounded fixtures, run state and sanitized request journal
Environment validation; fake HTTP performs no network I/O
configurationChecks: Call GatewayLabConfiguration.validate() during composition; production fake mode and public hosts in fake/sandbox mode are rejected.
restrictions: No standalone server, webhook simulator, real payment port/fake, or live provider adapter
Fake HTTP never falls back to network
